title: Integrating Language Models into Direct Speech Translation: An Inference-Time Solution to Control Gender Inflection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating gender accuracy and term coverage on the MuST-SHE benchmark to measure the correct generation of feminine and masculine inflections for speaker-dependent words in direct speech translation. This includes testing on a simulated scenario where the speakers' vocal traits conflict with their specified target gender to assess reliance on stereotypical acoustic cues.
